title: Gayatri Mantra
original_text: ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात्
translated_text: We meditate upon the divine glory of the celestial sun Tavitur. May he illuminate our intellect.
transliteration: Om bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ tat savitur vareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt.

title: Mahamrityunjaya Mantra
original_text: ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान् मृत्योर्मुक्षीय मामृतात्
translated_text: We worship the three-eyed Lord who nourishes all. May He liberate us from death and lead us to immortality.
transliteration: Om tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam urvārukamiva bandhanān mṛtyormukṣīya māmṛtāt.

title: Om Mani Padme Hum
translated_text: The jewel is in the lotus — a prayer for the purification of body, speech, and mind.

title: Ganesh Mantra
original_text: वक्रतुण्ड महाकाय सूर्यकोटि समप्रभ निर्विघ्नं कुरु मे देव सर्वकार्येषु सर्वदा
translated_text: O Lord Ganesha, of curved trunk and great body, with the brilliance of ten million suns, remove all obstacles from all my endeavors, always.
transliteration: Vakra tuṇḍa mahākāya sūryakoṭi samaprabha nirvighnaṃ kuru me deva sarvakāryeṣu sarvadā.

title: Shiva Mantra
translated_text: Om, I bow to Lord Shiva — the auspicious one, the transformer.

title: Saraswati Mantra
translated_text: Om, I bow to Goddess Saraswati — the goddess of knowledge, music, and art.

title: Lakshmi Mantra
translated_text: Om, I bow to Goddess Lakshmi — the goddess of wealth and prosperity.

title: Vishnu Mantra
translated_text: Om, I bow to Lord Vasudeva (Vishnu), the preserver of the universe.

title: Hanuman Chalisa (Opening)
original_text: श्रीगुरु चरन सरोज रज, निज मनु मुकुरु सुधारि। बरनउँ रघुबर बिमल जसु, जो दायकु फल चारि॥
translated_text: At the feet of the Guru, cleansing the mirror of my mind, I sing the pure glory of Raguvara, which bestows the four fruits of life.
transliteration: Śrīguru charan saroja raja, nija mana mukuru sudhāri. Baranau Raghubara bimala jasu, jo dāyaku phala chāri.

title: Vishnu Sahasranama (Opening)
translated_text: Vishnu is the universe, the all-pervading Lord of all beings, the ruler of past, present, and future.
